bundles.label: Turn Runner
bundles.description: The common request boundary, turn input, prompt assembly, provider request/stream, tools, reducer, retry, stop, and final summary.

bundles.label: Config Sources
bundles.description: Environment/file/CLI config sources, merge strategies, and validators.

bundles.label: Contract Ledger
bundles.description: Block manifests, capability refs, resources, recipe bindings, and conformance refs.

bundles.label: Identity / Event / Trace
bundles.description: Stable IDs, clocks, workspace resolution, event envelope/log/projection, and trace recording.

bundles.label: Nanobot Product Shells
bundles.description: Nanobot CLI, SDK, TUI, web, server, gateway, and other product entry surfaces.

bundles.label: Nanobot Provider
bundles.description: Nanobot provider registry, model/auth/request/stream/usage adapters, and stream evidence projectors.

bundles.label: Nanobot Runtime Contract
bundles.description: Nanobot runtime defaults, compatibility metadata, capability/recipe aliases, event bridges, traces, and product gates.

bundles.label: Nanobot Session
bundles.description: Nanobot session storage, projection, branch/context/pagination, identity, and message part semantics.

bundles.label: Nanobot Tools / Extensions
bundles.description: Nanobot plugin or extension loader, tool registry bridge, schema/permission/result adapters, process runner, and filesystem bridge.

bundles.label: Nanobot Turn Loop
bundles.description: Nanobot native-like turn cadence, request boundary, provider runner, tool planner, retry, stop, compaction, and final summary.

bundles.label: Prompt / Resources
bundles.description: System prompt builder, model capability adapter, compaction adapter, resource discovery/loaders, grants, and tool renderer.

bundles.label: Cassette Provider
bundles.description: Offline provider replay using memory or JSONL cassettes for conformance and task parity.

bundles.label: OpenAI-compatible Provider
bundles.description: Fetch transport, API-key auth, model registry, request shape, SSE/JSON stream parsers, event normalizers, usage, and stream projector.

bundles.label: Runtime Assembly Core
bundles.description: Runtime module catalog, capability resolver, binding planner, lifecycle runner, lockfile graph, and acceptance evidence.

bundles.label: Memory Session
bundles.description: In-memory session storage, event log, message store, branch graph, projector, context selector, and message-part projector.

bundles.label: Session Service Contracts
bundles.description: Service-facing session reader/writer/store/branch/context/pagination contracts for product adapters.

bundles.label: Filesystem / Shell Tools
bundles.description: Filesystem and shell tool packs, process runners, executors, result formats, permissions, and audit.

bundles.label: Tool Schema / Permission
bundles.description: Schema conversion, permission policies, echo/meta tool packs, and result truncation.

bundles.label: Basic UI
bundles.description: Shared UI command router, input normalizer, renderers, snapshots, themes, and TUI event loop.
